CustomField.label: Registered Count
CustomField.description: Roll-Up Summary COUNT of all active Event_Registration__c child records where Registration_Status__c is not Cancelled. Includes Registered, Waitlisted, Attended, and No Show. Used for pre-event capacity monitoring against venue capacity and expected attendees.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The current number of active registrations for this event (excludes cancelled). Used to monitor capacity before the event.
